contract:
Contract ListBookHistory::listReservationBook(uid: String): Set(BookCopy) {
	definition:
		u: User = User.allInstances()->any(x: User|x.UserID = uid)
	precondition:
		User.allInstances()->exists(x: User|x.UserID = uid) and
		u.ReservedBook.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		result = u.ReservedBook->projectSet(r: Reserve|r.ReservedCopy)
}
